repos.description: Windows inside a Docker container.
repos.summary_zh: dockur/windows 仓库提供 Docker 镜像，在容器内运行完整 Windows 操作系统。集成 ISO 自动下载、KVM 硬件加速和 Web 远程查看器，支持 Win11/10/服务器等多版本。通过 Docker Compose、CLI 或 Kubernetes 快速部署，适用于开发测试、遗留软件兼容、云原生 Windows 应用托管等场景。亮点包括全自动安装流程、硬件加速及多平台集成，极大简化 Windows 虚拟化部署。
repos.summary_en: The dockur/windows repository delivers a Docker image for running full Windows operating systems inside containers. It features automatic ISO downloading, KVM hardware acceleration, and a web-based viewer. Supporting Windows 11, 10, servers, and older versions, it enables quick deployment via Docker Compose, CLI, or Kubernetes. Ideal for development/testing, legacy software support, and containerized Windows apps in cloud or Linux environments. Highlights include fully automated setup, performance acceleration, and broad DevOps integration.

repos.description: Run macOS VM in a Docker! Run near native OSX-KVM in Docker! X11 Forwarding! CI/CD for OS X Security Research! Docker mac Containers.
repos.summary_zh: Docker-OSX通过KVM和OpenCore技术实现在Docker容器中运行接近原生性能的macOS虚拟机。支持X11图形转发和iPhone USB设备穿透，专为macOS安全研究（如iMessage漏洞分析）和自动化CI/CD流程设计，提供便携且隔离的测试环境，显著提升安全研究员的工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Docker-OSX leverages KVM and OpenCore to run near-native macOS virtual machines inside Docker containers. It features X11 GUI forwarding and iPhone USB passthrough, specifically designed for macOS security research (including iMessage analysis) and CI/CD automation. This solution provides security researchers with a portable, isolated, and reproducible testing environment for efficient vulnerability discovery.

repos.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: GitHubDaily 是一个运营近十年的开源项目策展平台，累计分享超10000个高质量开源项目。通过GitHub仓库、公众号、微博等多渠道，系统化推荐技术教程、开发者工具与行业资讯，核心价值在于从海量项目中筛选高价值内容，并按AI工具、开发工具等维度结构化整理，助力开发者拓展技术视野与提升编程能力。
repos.summary_en: GitHubDaily is a decade-old open source curation platform that has shared over 10,000 high-quality projects. Through multiple channels including GitHub, WeChat, and Twitter, it systematically recommends technical tutorials, developer tools, and industry insights. Its core value lies in filtering high-value content from massive repositories and organizing it into structured categories like AI tools and development utilities, helping developers expand technical horizons and enhance programming skills.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2025 Demo] PDF scientific paper translation with preserved formats - 基于 AI 完整保留排版的 PDF 文档全文双语翻译，支持 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等服务，提供 CLI/GUI/MCP/Docker/Zotero
repos.summary_zh: PDFMathTranslate 是一款专注于科技文献的PDF翻译工具，核心优势在于完整保留原始排版。支持公式、图表、目录、注释等复杂元素的精准定位与翻译。集成Google、DeepL、Ollama、OpenAI等多引擎，提供CLI、GUI、Docker及Zotero插件等多种使用方式。适用于学术研究、论文阅读等场景，支持多语言互译，确保学术文档的专业性与可读性。
repos.summary_en: PDFMathTranslate is a specialized PDF translation tool for scientific documents that preserves original layouts with high fidelity. It accurately handles complex elements including formulas, charts, tables of contents, and annotations. The tool integrates multiple translation backends such as Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI, offering flexible deployment via CLI, GUI, Docker, and Zotero plugins. Designed for academic research and paper reading, it supports multilingual translation while maintaining the professional quality and readability of scholarly documents.

repos.description: Huly — All-in-One Project Management Platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion)
repos.summary_zh: Huly Platform 是开源一体化项目管理平台，替代 Jira、Linear 等工具。提供 Chat、CRM、HRM、ATS 等模块化应用，支持自托管与 API 驱动开发。基于 Node.js 全栈框架，采用 Docker 容器化部署，加速企业级业务应用构建，实现多团队协作与流程自动化。
repos.summary_en: Huly Platform is an open-source all-in-one project management solution that replaces Jira, Linear, Slack, and Notion. It provides modular applications including Chat, CRM, HRM, and ATS with self-hosting capability. Built on a Node.js full-stack framework using Docker containerization, it accelerates enterprise business application development through API-driven integration and automated workflows for team collaboration.

repos.description: Lightweight server monitoring with historical data, docker stats, and alerts.
repos.summary_zh: Beszel 是一款基于 PocketBase 的轻量级服务器监控平台，采用 hub-agent 架构。它提供 Docker 容器资源统计、历史数据追踪和自定义告警功能，支持多用户管理、OAuth 认证与自动备份。相比主流方案资源占用更低，具备友好 Web 界面，开箱即用，适合个人及小型团队监控物理服务器、虚拟机和容器化环境。
repos.summary_en: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform built on PocketBase using a hub-agent architecture. It tracks Docker container metrics, historical data, and configurable alerts while supporting multi-user management, OAuth authentication, and automatic backups. With significantly lower resource consumption than leading solutions and an intuitive web interface, it's ideal for individuals and small teams monitoring physical servers, VMs, and containerized environments.

repos.description: 🥢像老乡鸡🐔那样做饭。已添加2026年发布的《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告 2.0中新出现的菜品。主要部分于2024年完工，非老乡鸡官方仓库。文字来自《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》，并做归纳、编辑与整理。CookLikeHOC.
repos.summary_zh: 将老乡鸡标准化菜谱开源化，基于《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》整理，提供可复制的家庭烹饪指南。技术亮点包括Docker容器化部署、AI手绘图解流程、网页端交互界面。核心价值在于中餐标准化与规模化烹饪方案的平民化，适合家庭烹饪爱好者与餐饮技术研究者。
repos.summary_en: This repository open-sources standardized recipes from Laoxiangji, compiled from their traceability reports to provide replicable home cooking guides. Technical highlights include Docker containerization, AI-generated hand-drawn illustrations, and a web interface. It democratizes Chinese restaurant-standardized cooking methods for home cooks and culinary tech enthusiasts.

repos.description: Why is this running? Trace any process, port, container, or file back to what started it - CLI + TUI.
repos.summary_zh: witr是一款跨平台系统诊断工具，专为回答“为什么在运行”而生。它通过CLI或交互式TUI，一键追溯任意进程、端口、容器或文件的完整启动因果链，覆盖systemd、Docker、PM2等监督层，输出人类可读报告或JSON，补全传统ps/lsof工具的因果盲区，助力运维与排障。
repos.summary_en: witr is a cross-platform diagnostic CLI+TUI tool that answers “Why is this running?”. It traces any process, port, container or file back to its full startup causality chain—including supervisors like systemd, Docker and PM2—delivering human-readable output or machine-readable JSON in one command, filling the gap left by traditional tools like ps and lsof.

repos.description: Open-source gym & body-weight tracker, now in the App Store (iPhone + Apple Watch) and as an Android APK. Plan routines, log workouts, see which muscles are trained, import from Strong/Hevy/FitNotes. Self-host it or use it on the phone alone.
repos.summary_zh: openGym 是一款自托管健身与体重追踪应用，支持训练计划、组数记录、肌肉疲劳分析、跨设备同步与 Passkey 登录。数据完全由用户掌控，支持从 FitNotes/Strong/Hevy 导入，提供 Android APK 与 Web 端，是隐私优先的开源健身管理方案。
repos.summary_en: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker that lets you plan weekly routines, log every set including supersets, warm-ups, and cardio, and visualize which muscles are trained, fatigued, or detrained. It supports cross-device sync, passkey login, and data import from FitNotes, Strong, and Hevy. Your data stays on your own server, giving you full ownership and privacy. Available as a web app and Android APK, it's a privacy-first, open-source alternative to commercial fitness subscriptions, with stats dashboards featuring heatmaps, charts, and personal records.

repos.description: A self hosted virtual browser that runs in docker and uses WebRTC.
repos.summary_zh: Neko 是一款基于 Docker 的自托管虚拟浏览器，通过 WebRTC 实现低延迟桌面流传输。它提供安全隔离的浏览器环境，支持多用户同时访问，适用于隐私保护、团队协作和社交娱乐（如在线观影派对）。项目解决了传统共享方式（如 Discord）的崩溃问题，为远程互动提供稳定解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser running in Docker, streaming desktop via WebRTC. It offers a secure, isolated browsing environment with multi-user access, ideal for privacy protection, team collaboration, and social entertainment (e.g., watch parties). Designed to overcome instability of traditional sharing tools like Discord, it provides a stable, low-latency solution for remote interaction.

repos.description: macOS inside a Docker container.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过Docker容器化技术结合KVM硬件加速，在非Apple硬件上实现macOS虚拟化。提供Web管理界面，支持macOS 11-15版本自动部署与灵活资源配置（存储/CPU/内存）。适用于iOS/macOS应用开发测试、CI/CD流水线及跨平台开发环境，为开发者提供无需Apple硬件的macOS虚拟化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This project enables macOS virtualization on non-Apple hardware through Docker containerization with KVM hardware acceleration. It features web-based management, automated deployment of macOS versions 11-15 (Big Sur to Sequoia), and flexible configuration of storage, CPU, and RAM resources. Supporting Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and GitHub Codespaces deployment, it is ideal for iOS/macOS app development testing, CI/CD pipelines, and cross-platform development environments, providing developers with a convenient, production-ready macOS virtualization solution without Apple hardware requirements.

repos.description: Self-hosted, plugin-based server management.
repos.summary_zh: Termix是一款开源自托管的Web服务器管理平台，为系统管理员提供一体化运维解决方案。核心功能包括：全功能SSH终端（支持分屏与标签页）、SSH隧道管理（自动重连与健康监测）、远程文件管理（支持代码/媒体编辑与Sudo权限）、Docker容器管控及服务器监控（CPU/内存/磁盘/防火墙）。采用React+Tailwind构建现代化响应式界面，支持RBAC权限体系、OIDC/2FA认证与SQLite数据库加密，是Termius的开源免费替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Termix is an open-source, self-hosted web platform for comprehensive server infrastructure management. It provides a full-featured SSH terminal with split-screen and tab support, automated SSH tunneling with health monitoring, and a remote file manager with sudo privileges. The platform integrates Docker container management, real-time server monitoring (CPU/memory/disk/network/firewall), and RBAC-based team collaboration. Built with React and Tailwind CSS, it features OIDC/2FA authentication, encrypted SQLite storage, and automatic SSL setup, serving as a free, all-in-one alternative to commercial solutions like Termius.

repos.description: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative
repos.summary_zh: Kiri 是一款用 Rust 编写的轻量级容器运行时，兼容 Docker CLI、Compose 与 buildx，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它通过单个小型 Linux 虚拟机运行容器，启动速度比 Docker Desktop 快约 80 倍，内存占用仅约 15 MB，并内置本地域名、HTTPS 证书、Kubernetes 集群及多语言界面，是 Docker Desktop 和 OrbStack 的高效替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Kiri is a lightweight container runtime written in Rust, compatible with Docker CLI, Compose, and buildx on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It runs containers in a single small Linux VM, starting about 80x faster than Docker Desktop with ~15 MB memory footprint. It offers local domains, HTTPS certificates, a one-command Kubernetes cluster, and a 38-language UI, serving as a fast alternative to Docker Desktop and OrbStack.

repos.description: Agent skill that turns natural language, code, Terraform/K8s, SQL, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protobuf and GraphQL sources into editable, tested draw.io architecture diagrams: incremental sync, multi-view projection, drift diff, CI architecture tests, whiteboard derasterize, interactive HTML/PPTX/Mermaid exports.
repos.summary_zh: drawio-skill 是一款 AI 驱动的技能，将自然语言描述转化为专业的 draw.io 图表。它支持 6 种预设类型（ERD、UML、序列、架构、ML/深度学习、流程图）、代码库（Python/JS/Go/Rust）结构可视化、10,000+ 官方形状搜索及 321 个 AI/LLM 品牌 logo。集成视觉自检与最多 5 轮迭代精炼，自动修复布局问题，支持 PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG 导出。与 Claude、Cursor 等多种 AI 代理兼容，适用于软件架构设计、代码可视化及系统文档生成场景。
repos.summary_en: drawio-skill is an AI agent skill that converts natural language into professional draw.io diagrams. It offers 6 presets (ERD, UML, Sequence, Architecture, ML/Deep Learning, Flowchart), codebase visualization for Python/JS/Go/Rust via Graphviz auto-layout, search across 10,000+ official shapes, and 321 AI/LLM logos. Features vision self-check with up to 5 rounds of refinement, auto-fixes layout issues, and exports to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor and other agents, ideal for architecture design, code analysis, and LLM app documentation.

repos.description: 🤖 A minimal and customizable Docker image running the Android emulator as a service.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供基于Alpine的最小化Docker镜像，用于将Android模拟器作为服务运行。支持KVM硬件加速和GPU加速（CUDA），可自定义Android版本与设备类型，内置ADB端口转发，兼容scrcpy远程控屏。专为CI/CD农场设计，提供无头运行模式，镜像体积可压缩至138MB（不含SDK），适用于自动化测试与远程Android开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Repository provides a minimal Alpine-based Docker image that runs Android emulator as a service. Features KVM hardware acceleration and GPU support (CUDA), customizable Android versions/device types, built-in ADB port forwarding, and scrcpy compatibility for remote screen control. Designed for headless CI/CD farms, the image can be compressed to 138MB (SDK-free variant). Ideal for automated testing and remote Android development with optimized performance and network accessibility.

repos.description: 自建 Docker 镜像加速与管理服务。零磁盘缓存、可视化面板、支持上游账号认证，支持一键部署Docker、K8s、Quay、Ghcr、Mcr、elastic、nvcr等镜像加速
repos.summary_zh: 该项目提供一键部署的Docker镜像加速服务，基于官方Registry支持Docker Hub、K8s、Quay等主流仓库代理。支持自动配置反向代理（Nginx/Caddy）、缓存控制、IP黑白名单及私有镜像拉取，解决国内镜像下载慢和频率限制问题。可部署在自有服务器或ClawCloud/Render等免费平台，附带Web管理面板实现镜像搜索与容器监控。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a one-click deployable Docker image acceleration service based on the official Registry, supporting proxies for Docker Hub, K8s, Quay, and other major registries. It features automatic reverse proxy (Nginx/Caddy) setup, cache control, IP whitelisting/blacklisting, and private image pulling to address slow downloads and rate limits in China. It can be deployed on private servers or free platforms like ClawCloud/Render, with a web management panel for image search and container monitoring.

repos.description: Virtual DSM in a Docker container.
repos.summary_zh: vdsm/virtual-dsm 是一个创新的轻量级 NAS 解决方案，通过在 Docker 容器中虚拟化运行 Synology DSM 系统，结合 KVM 硬件加速技术实现接近原生的性能表现。项目支持多磁盘管理、物理设备直通、CPU 与内存灵活配置，可快速部署于 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 平台，适用于个人私有云存储、开发测试环境及轻量级生产场景。
repos.summary_en: vdsm/virtual-dsm is an innovative lightweight NAS solution that virtualizes Synology DSM within Docker containers, leveraging KVM hardware acceleration to deliver near-native performance. This project provides comprehensive storage virtualization capabilities including multi-disk management, raw device passthrough, and dynamic resource allocation for CPU and memory. With support for Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and GitHub Codespaces, it enables rapid deployment across Linux, Windows, and macOS platforms. The solution is particularly suited for personal cloud storage, development testing environments, and scenarios requiring flexible, containerized NAS infrastructure with enterprise-grade features.

repos.description: PDF scientific paper translation with preserved formats - 基于 AI 完整保留排版的 PDF 文档全文双语翻译，支持 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等服务，提供 CLI/GUI/Docker
repos.summary_zh: PDFMathTranslate-next是一款基于AI的PDF科学论文翻译工具，能完整保留原文排版、公式、图表及注释，支持Google、DeepL、Ollama、OpenAI等多种翻译服务。提供CLI、GUI和Docker三种部署方式，适用于学术研究者进行双语对照阅读与分析。依托BabelDOC框架实现高保真格式翻译，显著提升科研效率。
repos.summary_en: PDFMathTranslate-next is an AI-powered tool for translating scientific PDF papers while fully preserving layout, formulas, charts, and annotations. It supports multiple services including Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI, offering CLI, GUI, and Docker interfaces. Ideal for researchers to read and analyze academic documents bilingually. Built on BabelDOC for high-fidelity format retention, boosting research efficiency.

repos.description: Open source AI terminal for cloud and infrastructure management, enabling you to deploy, troubleshoot, and automate services using natural language and intelligent agents.
repos.summary_zh: Chaterm是一款AI原生的智能终端代理，旨在成为DevOps副驾驶。它通过自然语言交互重塑传统命令行体验，内置专家知识库和自主Agent引擎，可自动分解复杂任务并执行从日志分析到服务回滚的全链路操作。支持EC2、数据库和Kubernetes管理，提供智能上下文补全和移动端语音交互能力，消除技术栈认知壁垒，让开发者具备资深SRE的运维能力。
repos.summary_en: Chaterm is an AI-native intelligent terminal agent designed as a DevOps co-pilot. It revolutionizes the command-line experience through natural language interaction, featuring a built-in expert knowledge base and autonomous agent engine capable of planning and executing complex workflows from log analysis to service rollback. It manages EC2 instances, databases, and Kubernetes clusters while offering intelligent contextual completion and real-time voice interaction on mobile devices, empowering developers with SRE-level operational capabilities.

repos.description: Your Self-Hosted Knowledge Base
repos.summary_zh: NoteDiscovery 是一款轻量级自托管笔记与知识库应用，强调数据隐私与所有权。采用纯 Markdown 文件存储，支持知识图谱可视化、LaTeX 数学、Mermaid 图表、内置绘图编辑器及插件扩展。通过 MCP 协议实现与 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 助手的深度集成，支持笔记搜索、创建与组织。提供美观响应式界面、可选认证和多语言支持，是 Notion、Obsidian 的免费开源替代方案，适合开发者、知识工作者及隐私敏感用户，Docker 一键部署，无订阅费用与厂商锁定。
repos.summary_en: NoteDiscovery is a lightweight self-hosted note-taking and knowledge base application that empowers users with full control over their data. Notes are stored as plain Markdown files, featuring an elegant web UI with graph visualization, LaTeX/MathJax support, Mermaid diagrams, a drawing editor, and extensive customization via themes and plugins. It stands out with MCP integration for AI tools like Claude and Cursor, enabling direct note search, creation, and organization. Responsive across devices with optional auth and multi-language support, it serves as a free, open-source alternative to Notion or Obsidian for privacy-focused developers and knowledge workers, with effortless Docker deployment and zero subscriptions or lock-in.

repos.description: 🌩️ Serverless 自托管的文件管理与文本分享工具/网盘，支持多存储聚合管理和WebDAV 服务挂载。兼容 S3、WebDAV、OneDrive、Google Drive、Telegram、HF、GitHub 等。内置   Markdown 编辑器、30+文件格式预览。支持 Cloudflare Workers 或 Docker 部署。
repos.summary_zh: CloudPaste 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Serverless 自托管网盘，核心价值在于多云存储聚合管理与零运维部署。支持 S3、OneDrive、Google Drive 等 30+ 存储后端，提供统一 WebDAV 挂载。内置 Vditor Markdown 编辑器与 30+ 文件格式预览，实现个人知识库管理与团队协作。通过边缘计算实现全球加速，Docker 部署提供本地灵活性。
repos.summary_en: CloudPaste is a Serverless self-hosted cloud storage built on Cloudflare Workers, aggregating 30+ storage backends including S3, OneDrive, and Google Drive with unified WebDAV mounting. It features a Vditor Markdown editor, 30+ file format previews, and edge computing acceleration across 300+ global nodes. Offering zero-maintenance deployment via Workers or Docker, it serves as an ideal solution for personal knowledge management and team collaboration.

repos.description: AI deep-research agent that turns any question into a cited report: plans searches, reads real sources, verifies evidence. Self-hosted, multi-provider, Docker-ready.
repos.summary_zh: 基于深度研究的AI助手，通过迭代搜索与LLM实现自动化信息挖掘。支持DeepSeek R1等主流模型，提供树状可视化研究流程与实时流式反馈。采用浏览器本地化处理确保数据安全，集成Tavily/Firecrawl多源搜索。支持PDF导出与Docker部署，适用于学术研究、市场分析等深度调研场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered research assistant that automates deep information gathering through iterative search and LLM reasoning. Features real-time streaming feedback and tree-structured visualization of research processes. Supports DeepSeek R1 and major LLM providers with local browser processing for data privacy. Integrates Tavily and Firecrawl for web search, offers PDF export, Docker deployment, and server mode. Ideal for academic research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence requiring comprehensive, automated investigation with full citation tracking.

repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 基于 FastAPI 构建 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持聊天补全、图像编辑、视频生成及 Anthropic 接口。核心亮点包括多账号池管理、流式输出、工具调用、本地缓存与自动维护。提供 Docker 一键部署（含防 Cloudflare 方案）、内置 Admin 后台与 WebUI，适用于 AI 应用集成与多模态内容生成。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based Grok gateway exposing web capabilities via OpenAI-compatible APIs for chat, image editing, video generation, and Anthropic endpoints. Key highlights: multi-account pooling, streaming, tool calling, local caching, auto-maintenance. Offers Docker deployment with anti-CF options, admin panel, and WebUIs. Ideal for AI app integration and multimodal tasks.

repos.description: Secure MCP runtime for AI agents to operate local machines, servers, and containers with multi-device orchestration.
repos.summary_zh: AgentDock 为 AI 智能体提供安全 MCP 运行时，支持多设备编排与跨平台控制。通过统一 MCP 接口实现文件、命令、Git、浏览器自动化等操作，兼容 ChatGPT、Claude 等客户端。支持多实例连接同一对话协调跨设备工作，具备明确权限边界、任务可恢复性和技能扩展能力，适用于开发部署、运维管理和真实环境自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: AgentDock is a secure MCP runtime empowering AI agents with controlled access to local machines, servers, and containers via multi-device orchestration. It unifies file operations, command execution, Git, browser automation, and extensible Skills into an MCP interface compatible with clients like ChatGPT and Claude. Multiple instances connect to one conversation for cross-device coordination, featuring explicit permissions, recoverable tasks, and structured results. Ideal for development, deployment, and operations beyond coding quotas across platforms.

repos.description: 👏 Make learning a lifelong habit. 学无止境
repos.summary_zh: my-geektime 是极客时间VIP课程的音视频私有化部署系统。支持一次缓存永久观看，一键发布课程为在线文档，以及本地音视频下载。基于Docker容器化技术，提供跨平台部署能力，实现学习资源的离线管理与在线访问，适合构建个人终身学习知识库。
repos.summary_en: my-geektime is a self-hosted GeekTime VIP course platform specializing in audio/video resource management. It enables permanent offline viewing through one-time caching, one-click online documentation publishing, and local media downloads. Built with Docker containerization for cross-platform deployment (amd64/arm64), it transforms streaming content into private learning assets. This tool eliminates dependency on official servers, providing lifelong access to purchased courses while maintaining content organization, search capabilities, and seamless playback functionality for individual learners.

repos.description: 🚀 OpenAI-compatible Freebuff proxy with dynamic free-agent tracking, token rotation, and ready-to-use Docker deployment.
repos.summary_zh: Freebuff2API 是一个 OpenAI 兼容代理服务器，将 Freebuff 免费 AI 模型转换为标准 OpenAI API 格式。支持多账号 token 自动轮换提升调用额度，动态模拟官方 SDK 指纹规避检测，并提供 Docker 快速部署。适用于开发者在不更换现有 OpenAI SDK 代码的前提下，零成本调用 Freebuff 的 AI 模型服务。
repos.summary_en: Freebuff2API is an OpenAI-compatible proxy server that transforms Freebuff's free AI models into standard OpenAI API endpoints. It features automatic multi-token rotation for higher throughput, dynamic client fingerprinting to mimic official SDK behavior, and Docker deployment. Enables developers to use Freebuff's AI services with any OpenAI-compatible client without code changes.

repos.description: OpenAI-compatible Web Chat API proxy with GPT, Grok, Gemini account management and Docker self-hosting
repos.summary_zh: webchat2api 将 ChatGPT Web、Grok/xAI Web 与 Gemini Web 逆向封装为 OpenAI 兼容及 Gemini 原生 API 代理，支持多账号池管理、文生文/文生图、tier 感知调度与 Docker 一键自托管。提供 FastAPI 后端与 Next.js 管理后台，覆盖账号导入、代理配置、内容过滤、云备份及图片存储，适合个人学习与私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: webchat2api wraps ChatGPT Web, Grok/xAI Web and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible and Gemini native API proxies, with multi-account pools, text/image generation, tier-aware routing and Docker self-hosting. Features FastAPI backend plus Next.js admin UI for account management, proxies, content filtering, cloud backup and image storage—ideal for personal research and private deployments.

repos.description: 基于 Cookie/Token 认证、自动绕过 Cloudflare (CF) 人机验证、高级反检测伪装、高速流式 API 转换、Docker 一键部署
repos.summary_zh: notion-2api 是一个将 Notion AI 非官方接口转换为 OpenAI 兼容格式的高性能代理层。基于 FastAPI 和 cloudscraper 实现 Cloudflare 绕过与反检测，支持流式响应和多模型调用。Docker 一键部署让任意 OpenAI API 客户端无缝接入 Notion AI 能力，适用于自动化脚本、AI 应用集成等场景。
repos.summary_en: notion-2api is a high-performance proxy service that transforms Notion AI's unofficial backend into a fully compatible OpenAI API interface. Leveraging FastAPI and cloudscraper, it automatically bypasses Cloudflare protection while implementing advanced anti-detection mechanisms. The solution supports real-time streaming responses (stream=true) and maintains session state across multiple models. With Docker-based deployment, developers can instantly provision a private API endpoint, enabling any OpenAI-compatible application or script to harness Notion AI's capabilities without official API access.

repos.description: 一个基于 Next.js 开发的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理私服，支持一键部署到Vercel。解决国内 Pull 镜像困难问题。
repos.summary_zh: Pocker 是基于 Next.js 的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理系统，专为解决国内 Docker Hub 拉取缓慢而设计。系统通过 GitHub Actions 自动化将镜像转存至华为云 SWR，支持一键 Vercel 部署、多区域节点切换、镜像/标签/命名空间全生命周期管理，并提供用量统计与暗黑模式。让每个人都能拥有自主可控的 Docker 私服。
repos.summary_en: Pocker is a full-stack Docker registry management system built with Next.js, designed to solve slow Docker Hub pulls in China. It automatically transfers images to Huawei Cloud SWR via GitHub Actions, enabling one-click Vercel deployment. Key features include multi-region node switching (23 global nodes), complete lifecycle management of images/tags/namespaces, usage statistics, dark mode, and automated workflows. It empowers individuals and teams to own private Docker registries with full data control and security.
